# Aryan Gupta Portfolio

Aryan Gupta is a full-stack developer, AI engineer, and mainframe systems engineer based in India. This portfolio documents his experience, skills, shipped projects, awards, and contact options.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio](https://www.lagaryan.click/): Experience, skills, selected projects, and contact links.
- [Terminal portfolio](https://www.lagaryan.click/cli): Plain-text portfolio for terminal clients.
- [Projects](https://www.lagaryan.click/#projects): Selected shipped work and source links.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.lagaryan.click/privacy-policy): Analytics and privacy information.
